title: White Grape Juice with Added Vitamin C, From Concentrate, Shelf Stable

content.title: About
content.content: White grape juice made from concentrate, enriched with vitamin C and shelf‑stable for storage at room temperature. It has a light, refreshing taste with mild sweetness and a characteristic grape aroma.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Grape juice is often used as a base for sauces, marinades, and desserts.
Added vitamin C boosts antioxidant capacity and improves iron absorption from foods.
Concentrated juice reduces transportation costs and preserves nutrients.
Shelf‑stable juice does not require refrigeration until the package is opened.
White grape juice is less aromatic than dark varieties, making it versatile for mixing with other drinks.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Grape juice contains polyphenols that help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports immune function
items.content: Vitamin C enhances immune defense and aids collagen synthesis.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: The juice is mostly water, helping maintain the body’s fluid balance.

items.title: Source of potassium
items.content: Potassium supports normal heart and muscle function.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The juice contains virtually no fat, making it suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Concentrated juice can have a high natural sugar level; people with diabetes should monitor portion size.

items.title: Grape allergy
items.content: Rarely, individuals may experience an allergic reaction to grape juice.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: The acidic nature may irritate a sensitive stomach or tooth enamel.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Drink chilled, use in cocktails, smoothies, culinary sauces, or dilute with water for a milder flavor. Pairs well with berries, mint, and citrus.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened packages in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 5‑7 days.
